lines.text: The root is Struct! Instruction, instrument.
Did you know? Struct is Latin for build.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus build?

words.ex: Follow the instructions on the box.

words.mean: a tool built for a job
words.ex: Do you play a musical instrument?
